summary: Diff shows frontend Daily Report dialog updated to display a backend-provided canonical "Period Total" and import normalization now defaults missing tip fields, but the backend aggregation changes for getDailyReport and UI support for entering voucher tips are not evidenced in the provided diff summary. Several unrelated UI/UX and styling changes appear to have been added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend daily report aggregation so per-day totals and summary Period Total are derived from the canonical formula and retain meter/tip breakdowns by payment method.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and contains no visible changes to getDailyReport aggregation logic; the diff summary does not provide evidence that the backend now computes per-day and summary periodTotal using the canonical formula.

missing_requirements.requirement: UI entry/edit must support voucher as a tip payment method and voucher tips must be optional (default 0 when absent) without validation failures.
missing_requirements.reason: Import normalization shows missing tip/tipPaymentMethod defaulting behavior, but there is no evidence in the diff summary that the Pickup entry/edit UI allows selecting voucher as tip payment method or that UI validation was updated accordingly.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (PickupForm/EditDeleteRecordDialog summaries do not mention voucher tip entry)

missing_requirements.requirement: Update all places where the app reports a primary owed/period total to always use the canonical formula everywhere (no legacy computations remain).
missing_requirements.reason: Evidence is provided for DailyReportDialog using canonical periodTotal, but the diff summary does not conclusively show all other locations that present a primary owed/period total have been updated (e.g., any other screens/reports besides Daily Report).
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (only explicitly calls out DailyReportDialog; other components mention totals but not the canonical formula)

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend consistently labels and displays the canonical formula-based value as the main reported total and does not substitute meter+tips in those locations.
missing_requirements.reason: DailyReportDialog summary indicates Period Total uses canonical value and Grand Total uses meter+tips, but the diff summary does not provide enough detail to verify that all other per-day/period total displays across the app are consistently using the canonical value and are labeled to avoid confusion.

hallucinated_features.description: Android Chrome/Radix overlay opacity, scroll-lock, and dropdown/modal behavior fixes across multiple components and global CSS.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest, which focuses on totals formula consistency and voucher tips optionality.

hallucinated_features.description: React Query hook restructuring/backward-compatible aliases, new cache invalidation behavior, and separate hooks for single-day vs range pickup fetching.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; requirements do not mention query-layer refactors.

hallucinated_features.description: Login and account setup UX changes (new messaging, connecting state gating).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; authentication provider changes were explicitly a non-goal and no login UX changes were requested.

hallucinated_features.description: PickupForm and record dialogs changes unrelated to totals formula/voucher tips (12-hour time picker, Pacific time conversion, default current time behavior, 30-day pickup history).
